businesses.title: Businesses
businesses.summary: A business is the commercial tenant. Each business has websites, memberships, rules and integration credentials.
actions: Create a business (name, slug, currency, payout threshold).
Open detail to manage websites and branding.
prerequisites: Requires platform admin or business admin role.

business-detail.title: Business detail
business-detail.summary: Edit business data and manage websites. Each website can have its own HMAC credentials and commission rules.
actions: Edit name, slug, currency and threshold.
Shortcuts to create a credential or rule on the website.
pitfalls: Removing a website with related events/credentials may fail due to FK constraints.

business-branding.title: Branding
business-branding.summary: Colours and logo applied to the referrer portal and invitation page for this business.
actions: Per website: fetch favicon/logo automatically from base_url.

memberships.title: Memberships
memberships.summary: Referrer memberships created via invitation. Approval requires an approved payment method and generates referral codes.

payment-methods.title: Payment methods
payment-methods.summary: Versioned history (IBAN/MB Way). Approved, rejected, pending and superseded versions.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.summary: Bearer + HMAC credentials per business/website/source for ingesting external checkout events.
actions: Create credential (stable source, e.g. node_checkout) with step-up password.
Rotate or revoke credentials (rotate also requires step-up).
prerequisites: Admin password for step-up on create/rotate.
pitfalls: Token and HMAC only appear on create/rotate.
Source is not a runtime: it is the channel identifier (idempotency).
Create/rotate fail with step_up_required until password is confirmed.

commission-rules.title: Commission rules
commission-rules.summary: Versioned rules in basis points. Can be global to the business or scoped to a website.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.summary: Invite referrers to a business with assigned websites. The plaintext token only appears on creation.

events.title: Commercial events
events.summary: Normalised events (sale/refund/chargeback) ingested via integration. Statuses: received, attributed, ignored.

payout-requests.title: Payouts
payout-requests.summary: Referrer settlement requests. AACT records the external payment; it does not transfer money.
actions: Approve, reject or mark as paid.

home.title: Referrer portal
home.summary: Referrer area: memberships, payment method, documents, balances, payouts and referral codes.
actions: Request payout when balance reaches the threshold.
